item.title: Anthropic and Pope Leo are apparently at odds about this controversial AI concept
item.description: Though the Vatican and the tech giant share concerns about rampant AI development, the idea that it is conscious is reportedly a sticking point. Even before AI made its way into all of our pockets, tech leaders spent decades warning the world about it. Anthropic has been particularly vocal about reckless AI development having disastrous consequences. It’s also reportedly been focused on AI consciousness and the moral implications. ...
